---
title: "Troubleshooting"
---

Start with the narrowest command that reproduces the problem. `doctor` inspects
the environment without running a benchmark, while `health` runs every
functional path. Most setup problems should begin with `doctor`.

```bash
uv run mlperf doctor
uv run mlperf doctor --workload image-classification --profile max
```

## The Command Is Missing or Uses the Wrong Python

Run commands from the `mlperf-edu` directory through the locked environment.

```bash
cd cs249r_book/mlperf-edu
uv sync --locked
uv run --project . python -c 'import sys; print(sys.executable)'
uv run --project . mlperf doctor
```

Avoid invoking a system-wide `pytest`, `python`, or `mlperf` executable for this
checkout. Contributors should use `uv run python -m pytest` after installing
the development extra.

## A Download Is Missing or Incomplete

Preview the assets before downloading, then inspect the cache.

```bash
uv run mlperf fetch --workload WORKLOAD --profile max --dry-run
uv run mlperf fetch --workload WORKLOAD --profile max
uv run mlperf cache list
uv run mlperf info --dataset DATASET
```

The fetcher verifies pinned evidence when the source provides it. Terms-gated
datasets may require a manual download and an environment-specific handoff.
Never replace a declared quality dataset with synthetic data. The runner fails
closed because a synthetic substitute cannot support the same claim.

## CUDA or MPS Is Unavailable

The default `--device auto` policy selects CUDA, then MPS, then CPU. An explicit
unavailable device fails before execution. Inspect the environment and retry on
CPU when the workload supports it.

```bash
uv run mlperf doctor --workload WORKLOAD --profile PROFILE
uv run mlperf run --workload WORKLOAD --profile PROFILE --device cpu
```

The report records both the requested and executed device. A CPU fallback may
change runtime, but it does not silently change the workload quality contract.

## The Target Was Missed

A target miss is not the same as a failed run. Check that the report shows
completed execution, the declared evaluation set, the expected metric and
target, and verified provenance. If those conditions hold, preserve the miss
as evidence. Do not tune the threshold to match the result.

The [readiness page](../readiness.qmd) lists four current target gaps that are
being investigated without changing their published reproduction points.

## Provenance Verification Failed

Verify the manifest from the unchanged result directory.

```bash
uv run mlperf verify path/to/result.provd.json
```

A changed model, dataset, report, or referenced file invalidates the recorded
hash. Restore the exact bytes or rerun the benchmark. Do not edit a manifest to
make verification pass.

## Packaging Was Refused

`mlperf package` intentionally refuses an archive when it would include
fetch-only, terms-gated, or release-review dataset bytes. Submit the verified
result directory or manifest under the course policy instead. The portable
packaging exercise uses the dataset-free `image-classification_min` artifact in
[Lab 5](../labs/05-assignment-package.qmd) and makes no quality claim.

## A Long Run Was Interrupted

The CLI does not yet provide a general `run --resume` option. Some legacy or
workload-specific runners preserve their own intermediate state, but that does
not create suite-wide recovery semantics. Before a long run, use `fetch`, run a
workload-specific `doctor` preflight, choose an explicit output directory, and
read the benchmark page for its current recovery boundary.

Do not add `--resume` to a command unless `uv run mlperf run --help` lists it.
The [local execution plan](https://github.com/harvard-edge/cs249r_book/blob/main/mlperf-edu/docs/internal/STATUS.md)
tracks general resumability as unfinished implementation work.

## MiniGo Cannot Start Locally

Reinforcement learning is a known local-execution blocker. Its functional `min`
path runs, but the quality-bearing `max` path needs a reviewed CUDA and
TensorFlow 1.x runtime on an NVIDIA system, which no laptop supplies. Inspect
the machine-readable handoff instead of treating an ordinary laptop failure as
a new regression.

```bash
uv run mlperf doctor --workload reinforcement-learning --profile max --format json
```

Recommendation is no longer in this category. It moved from DLRM on Criteo
Terabyte to the MLPerf Training v0.5 NCF contract on MovieLens-20M and now
trains locally in roughly half an hour. If it fails to start, treat that as a
genuine problem rather than an expected blocker.

## Collect a Diagnostic Bundle for a TA

Preserve the failing command, its terminal output, the selected workload, and
the environment summary. Do not include private credentials or manually
licensed dataset bytes.

```bash
uv run mlperf doctor --workload WORKLOAD --profile PROFILE --format json \
  > doctor.json
uv run mlperf run --workload WORKLOAD --profile PROFILE --dry-run \
  > selection.txt
```

Include the generated report and `.provd.json` manifest if execution reached
the artifact stage. These files usually contain enough detail to distinguish an
environment failure from a quality miss.
